svg.text: talk.01 · ROUND 6 · THE SIDE STRIP AS THE PUSH-TO-TALK KEY
six takes on one idea · beige with bright retro colours · matte printed finish · exposed screws · rainbow badge
TENTATIVE · NOT A FINAL DESIGN
original concepts · same scale in every card (10 mm = 40 px)
dashed = the strip in its flush, locked position · see strip-lever.svg
All: USB-C and a coiled cable on top · a small hatch and a small U stand on the back · the sleeve holds the strip flush.
A · FULL STRIP
beige + teal
lineage: the tape-deck / boombox reference (beige with teal), the whole left
side as the key
strip: full height, hinged at the bottom, a cut top corner; the sleeve slides
over its top
grille: horizontal lines mode: a thumb-pad wheel (1-4) cable: teal coil
+ the cleanest version of your idea; the cut corner makes the pop-up look
intentional
- an 85 mm strip may wobble; the seam shows
B · HALF STRIP
beige + orange + lavender
lineage: colour-blocked tape-deck panels; only the upper part pops, the lower
part is fixed
strip: upper 58% hinged at its lower end; a sleeve on the join holds it flush
grille: vertical slots mode: a cream wheel with an orange index cable:
orange coil
+ shorter strip: less wobble; the fixed lavender block is a thumb rest
- two parts on the left edge: the join must look deliberate
C · PLUNGER
teal + cream + orange
lineage: boombox buttons (teal) and the compo's orange translucent keys; an
inset key
strip: moves straight out on springs (about 2 mm), inset in a groove; a sleeve
at the bottom
grille: a dot-matrix field mode: two orange round buttons cable: teal coil
+ simplest motion; the gap is a dark seam; no angle to sell
- the whole strip must slide straight without sticking (two guides)
D · TRAPDOOR
mustard + red
lineage: a toy/transistor radio in mustard; the strip is hinged at the TOP and
flares at the bottom
strip: red, opens from the bottom, which is where the thumb rests; the sleeve
is at the bottom
grille: vertical slots mode: a black ribbed wheel cable: mustard coil
+ more travel where the thumb is; very eye-catching
- a long arm from the hinge: the bottom opens widest, so the angle must be
small
E · DECK
cream + teal + lavender
lineage: the first reference (a micro-cassette deck): teal top window,
lavender panel, piano keys
strip: silver, ribbed like the deck's side block; the sleeve is teal; a wedge
body leans back
grille: horizontal lines mode: a slider plus piano-key buttons cable: teal
coil
+ the most 'deck'; the wedge profile builds in the desk angle
- a wedge body is thicker at the base; a slider needs space
F · COMPO
silver-cream + orange
lineage: the compo stereo (stacked modules, exposed screws, orange translucent
keys and dial)
strip: silver; the orange sleeve; three panels with screws; the bottom panel
is the hatch
grille: horizontal lines mode: four orange keys + a translucent dial
cable: orange coil
+ screws as ornament; the modular look suits printed parts
- many small parts and keys; the busiest of the six
